text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature, victorious in the Arima 
Kinen, reflected on the grueling race and 
attributed her perseverance all the way to 
the finish line to "the support from all 
the fans."

And eager to grow even stronger, she tried 
to pry the secrets of strength from Mejiro 
McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.

To that question, the two of them promised 
to give a proper answer at a later date.

Giving a glimpse of new growth on the 
horizon... Nice Nature set her sights on 
her next goal, the Takarazuka Kinen.
